info.name: Plauda API — 24/7 AI Employee & Verified PayPal Commerce
info.description:
Official Postman Collection for **Plauda** (`https://plauda.fastapicloud.dev`).

Plauda gives every small and social-first business a 24/7 AI employee that chats from grounded store knowledge, recommends real in-stock products, builds structured order drafts, generates PayPal Orders v2 checkout links, verifies payment via signed PayPal webhooks, and logs sales to the merchant dashboard.

### Quick Automated Flow
1. Run **1. System & Health → Healthz** to verify live API + Supabase connectivity.
2. Run **2. Merchant Auth → Login** (or **Register**) — Postman automatically extracts `access_token`, `store_slug`, and `merchant_id` into collection/environment variables.
3. Run **7. Public Storefront & AI Agent Chat → Create Conversation** — Postman automatically saves `conversation_id` and `visitor_token`.
4. Run **Public Chat Turn** to stream an AI agent turn over SSE.
